label: Essential rows in a covering table
section: Essential rows in a covering table
subgoals: Scan each column for a single marking row
Select that row into the cover
Delete the columns the selected row covers

label: Column dominance
subgoals: List the set of rows that mark each column
Find pairs where one column's row set contains another's
Delete the column with the larger row set, keeping one of identical columns

label: Row dominance and the cyclic core
section: Row dominance and the cyclic core
subgoals: Delete a row whose columns are a subset of a no-costlier row's
Repeat essential selection and both dominance rules to a fixpoint
Hand the remaining cyclic core to branch and bound
